item.title: Doc - Episode 2.11 - Family Matters - Promotional Photos + Press Release
item.description: Promotional Photos Press Release The search for Amy's hacker intensifies when the hospital finally brings in the FBI. Hannah, devastated by the death of her patient, works with Amy to treat a sick older man whose daughter believes has been poisoned. Meanwhile, Sonya and TJ examine middle school kids for scoliosis, and discover a child with a different ailment and a home situation that may have caused it to get much worse. Source: FOX
